text_block_list.text:
One day, after things had finally settled 
down from the three years spent racing 
alongside Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy-poo~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Isn't now the time?! Hey, hey!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It's a reward! A reward!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Isn't now the only time for our reward 
day? Let's go on a hot springs trip~?

"Come to think of it, around the time she 
entered the Senior Class, 
Viシナリオ/Vivlos won a hot spring trip in 
the lottery. If I recall, back then—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"So why don't we make the hot springs trip 
a reward for me... and you, Trainy?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You've been working super hard too, 
Trainie. I want you to get a real reward!

—Receiving such thoughtfulness from her, I 
gently slipped the hot spring ticket into 
my planner.
choice_data_list:
(And I was the one who wanted to give her 
something...)

(When I'm the one who wants to give her 
something...)

text_block_list.text:
Through everything that happened, Vivlos 
worked so hard. Praise alone simply isn't 
enough.
choice_data_list:
(I want to give her some other kind of 
reward)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainie?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So, on our next day off! Let's go to a hot 
spring, okay?

"...Oh, how about inviting her family 
along on the trip? She loves her family 
dearly, so I'm sure it'd be a wonderful 
surprise."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I already told Papa and Mama that I'm 
going with Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to spend time with you, Trainie, 
so Papa and the others couldn't come, but 
they said to have fun♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah? Well, I'm counting on you, then♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You'd better... be suuuper excited for it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...All right. Let's do this~!

I need to think of a different reward for 
her. Normally speaking, it would be 
something high-class that she loves—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh, are you sure, Trainy?! This bag 
is..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it cost XXX-thousand yen♡ 
Thank youuu~"

It would surely be appreciated. But in my 
position, it would be inappropriate to act 
that way. ...Just then, something came to 
mind—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Give me a hug, then!

"I'll grant you one wish"... To that 
answer, she chose a hug. Of course, even 
now I can't—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: We're here~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, the vibe here is super nice♡ This 
spot was super popular on Umastagram, too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Train-chi! Take a cute picture 
of—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Not that! I'll take the picture!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'll make sure to use the app~.
choice_data_list: In that case, let's take one together.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Really? If that's what Trainy wants♡

And so, after taking a bunch of photos, 
each of us headed to the hot springs—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hanyaaa~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hmm... It was suuuper good!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainie, can you dry my hair? The tips are 
still a little—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, that's not right!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy, I'll dry your hair for you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, how about I put some 
hair oil on you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
They say applying this after using the 
hairdryer protects your hair!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "No! Let me do it, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I've decided that today, I'm gonna pamper 
Trai-guy to the max!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I blurted it out! It was supposed to 
be a secret~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's a reward, a reward! I told you I 
wanted to give you one too, Trainy, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, I wanted to give you 
something from myself, not just the hot 
springs."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You've really worked so, so hard for my 
sake, Trainie.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So…… Are you ready, Trainy?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Let yourself be spoiled, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I want to give you a reward too.
I want to give you a reward too

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: For me...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Sure...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Hyah.

I gave her head a few gentle pats. 
"Headpats"... That was another one of her 
little requests.

To pamper them... Coincidentally, they had 
both been thinking of the very same 
reward.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...I-I kinda... feel my heart racing... 
but.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer-san. —I'm so happy...
choice_data_list:
It doesn't seem like a celebrity thing at 
all, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Why? She's super wealthy, you know!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I mean, no one else... gets to experience 
a feeling like this, right?

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Vivlos...
